title: Glossary: account
body: An **account** is a single registration held at Northwind Financial, such as an individual brokerage, joint, IRA, Roth IRA, or cash management account. A client can hold several accounts.

title: Glossary: client
body: A **client** is a person or entity that owns at least one account. Joint owners count as one client record each.

title: Account opening handbook: what counts as active
body: For account opening and growth reporting, an **active account** is an account with status OPEN and a cash or securities balance greater than zero (a **funded** account). Login activity is not part of this definition.

title: Glossary: funded account
body: A **funded account** is an OPEN account with a balance greater than zero on the as-of date.

title: Glossary: dormant account
body: A **dormant account** is an OPEN account with no client-initiated activity (trade, transfer, or login) for 12 months or more.

title: Glossary: household
body: A **household** groups clients who share an address and an advisor relationship.

title: Procedure: change a client address (current)
body: To change a client address: 1. Verify identity with two-factor authentication in the service console. 2. Submit service request type ADDRESS_CHANGE with the new address. 3. The change takes effect within **1 business day**. 4. A confirmation letter is mailed to both the old and the new address.

title: Procedure: beneficiary change
body: To change a beneficiary on an IRA or transfer-on-death account: verify identity, collect the signed beneficiary form, submit service request type BENEFICIARY_CHANGE. Turnaround is 3 business days.

title: Procedure: close an account
body: To close an account: confirm a zero balance or a completed transfer out, submit service request type ACCOUNT_CLOSE, and record the closure reason code.

title: Glossary: primary advisor
body: The **primary advisor** is the advisor of record on the account. Each account has exactly one.

title: Service metrics guide: active accounts
body: For service and engagement dashboards, an **active account** is an OPEN account whose owner has **logged in within the last 90 days**. Balance is not considered.

title: Glossary: engaged account
body: Draft. An **engaged account** may be an OPEN account with a client login in the last 90 days. Needs an owner decision.

title: Glossary: service request
body: A **service request** is a client or advisor request handled by Client Service, such as an address change, beneficiary change, transfer, statement copy, or account closure.

title: Service level targets
body: Service level targets: address change 1 business day, beneficiary change 3 business days, transfer 5 business days, statement copy 2 business days.

title: Glossary: net new accounts
body: **Net new accounts** for a period = accounts opened in the period minus accounts closed in the period.

title: Glossary: average resolution time
body: **Resolution time** is the number of calendar days from when a service request is opened to when it is closed. Open requests are excluded.

title: Glossary: open service request
body: An **open service request** has status OPEN or IN_PROGRESS.

title: Glossary: advisor region
body: Advisors belong to one of four regions: Northeast, Southeast, Central, or West.

title: Procedure: change a client address (2019 version)
body: To change a client address the client must send a **signed letter by mail**. Operations keys the change after a medallion signature check. Allow **5 business days**.

title: Glossary: account type
body: Account types: Individual Brokerage, Joint Brokerage, Traditional IRA, Roth IRA, Cash Management.

title: Glossary: as-of date
body: Unless stated otherwise, reported counts use the data as of **2026-11-15**.

title: Procedure: reopen a closed account
body: A closed account can be reopened within 90 days of closure with a service request of type ACCOUNT_REOPEN.

title: Glossary: client tenure
body: **Client tenure** is the years since the client opened their first account.

title: Glossary: average balance
body: **Average balance** is the mean balance across funded accounts. Unfunded accounts are excluded.

title: Procedure: statement copy
body: Statement copies for the last 7 years are available in the client portal. Older statements need a service request of type STATEMENT_COPY.

title: Procedure: transfer between accounts
body: Transfers between accounts with the same owner can be submitted in the portal and settle the next business day.

title: Glossary: channel
body: Service requests arrive through one of three channels: Phone, Portal, or Branch.

title: Glossary: advisor book
body: An **advisor book** is the set of accounts where the advisor is the primary advisor.

title: Data office FAQ: which definition wins?
body: When two pages define the same term differently, the data product owner decides. The approved definition is published in the semantic view, and the other page is marked superseded.

title: Procedure: login troubleshooting
body: Clients reset portal passwords themselves. Locked accounts need a service request of type PASSWORD_RESET.
